//: The screens of game scenarios (13 §12, 12 §10.7): setting a scenario up, its introduction, the journal and the summary. A profile names `setup`, `intro` and `summary` for the roles of those names; a scenario may name its own for `intro` and `summary` in its `screens`. The setup screen reads `app.setup`, the scenario being set up: its places, the options it asks about and how its seed is chosen. Choosing a place begins the game there with the options as they stand.
title: Where to begin

list.empty: The scenario offers nowhere to begin.

tooltip.value: Up and Down choose, Enter begins, Esc goes back.

//: What a scenario's `intro` says, over the play screen as the game begins.
title: The story so far

//: The journal (14 §13): the objectives and missions of the game as the character knows them, each with how it stands and, for an active one with a marker, which way and how far the marker is. `view.objectives` is the character's own list: a marker follows what the character last perceived of its target, not where the target is. The `journal` control opens it.
title: Journal

list.item: {if it.depth > 0 then '  ' else ''}{if it.state == 'done' then '[x]' else if it.state == 'failed' or it.state == 'expired' then '[-]' else '[ ]'} {it.text}  <dim>{it.where}</>

//: How a game ended (13 §9.4): its outcome, how long it ran and how each objective stood. Leaving goes to the title, which ends the game.
title: The end
